verse: yena dṛṣṭena labdhena jñānena paramārthataḥ | dhyānena smaraṇenaiva guruṇoktena karmaṇā
karṣayedavikalpena kalpamānā svakā kalā | tridhā mātṛvadā tryantā tāraṇī tatvamadhyagā
pauṣṭikā tatsvarūpāntā mantrabhūmistu sā viduḥ | kalāntā sarvadevīnāṃ grāsate lālasā sadā
pūjānāmāni divyāni vadāmi bhavato hara | vaktra sarvajanakhāgre karṇe tu kathayāmi te
yoginīhṛdayāvasthaṃ prakaṭaṃ kuru śaṃkari ||1/ 55 ||
prathamaṃ sṛṣṭicakrasya gaṇādhyakṣo'aambikā saha | vaṭukaśca tataḥ pūjyo bhaktiyuktaśca bhūpatiḥ
vaktrād vaktragataṃ vyaktaṃ avyaktaṃ cakramadhyagam | tena cakrena vakṣyāmi vaktrāmnāyaṃ kramāyatam
sphurantī parame vyomni mantrabhūmistu sā viduḥ | adhyātmajñānarūpasya sadāntā paramāvyayā
uddharet tu viśānena sṛṣṭidaśamasaṃyutam | aṣṭamena adhaḥkrāntaṃ caturdaśamasaṃyutam
niḥsvabhāvamahāvasthā mantrabhūmistu sā viduḥ | sthulagā yāmadrodikkā (?) akṣarakṣaramadhyagā
bhūyād bhāsakalāntare kakuhare koṭyakālollāsinī kālākālavaghaṭṭanodbhaṭatadiḥ koṭiprabhā ṭiṭṭi bhā varṇādhvāntanamantarāntara tayā līnā kṛṣāntekṣayā nityaṃ bhedakalātmakasya sahasācchedāyamātmākarī
sarvasaṃhārakaṃ dīptaṃ nirguṇaṃ vyomavartinam | tena bhāvena sarvajña kālanirnāśanaṃ param
yā kalā kālajananī mantrabhūmistu sā viduḥ | citybhyantramaviṣṭā yā aṣṭakhaṇḍanaśūnyagā
sṛṣṭisthaṃ viddhi sarvajña saptamaṃ tvadhunā śṛṇu | sthitisthaṃ tu dvitīyaṃ syāt sṛṣṭiṣaṣṭhena saṃyutam
saṃsthitā paramārthena punarrakṣita tatpadam | akalātu kalākāśe kaśo kālakalanayā kalā
śiroruhaiśca taṃ sthānaṃ saṃśodhyaca vicakṣaṇaḥ | lepayet tu tathā rudra ṣasanyārupiṇena ca
tataḥ samuccared vidyāṃ sarvakāmaphalapradām | trayodaśaṃ tu saṃhārād sṛṣṭidaśamasaṃyutam
visargāntakalārūḍhā ṣoḍaśasvaramadhyagā | saptādaśīti sā kālī kriyā sarvāntakī kalā
teṣāṃ madhye mahābhīmo bhairavo vai nirāmayaḥ | suśrūṣo gaṅgado bhūtvā tasyārādhanatatparaḥ
teṣāṃ madhyāt kramāṇāṃ tu ādau pūjyastu kaḥ kramaḥ | tat me kathaya suśroṇi vistareṇa yathāvidhiḥ
sarvasyākṣararūpasya nakṣatrasya tathā vidhiḥ | bhāsayet sā parā kālī bhābhirugrābhitārakam
sṛṣṭisthaṃ saptamaṃ yad vai saṃhārādaṣṭasaṃyutam | navamaṃ taṃ vijāniyād daśamaṃ tvadhunā śṛṇu
etāḥ suraśmayaḥ proktāḥ śaktirūpāḥ sadoditāḥ | aṣṭau tu paramārthena sarvatra pānalampaṭāḥ
tithibhirya sadārūḍhaṃ sapakṣāpakṣavarjitam | niḥsvabhāvanibhau paśya nirlakṣaṃ niṣprayojanam
dvitīyavarṇarājeśaṃ viddhi sarvāvaḍāsakam | lakṣyā bījaṃ tato deva tṛtīyaṃ parikīrtitam
melāpe militā sā vai rasasya paramā citiḥ | (4) kapāṭadvayabhedena pakṣāpakṣadvayaratā
narake tu(?)* *? gṛhya pānago *? paraṃ param | ulkābhakṣyāstathā cānyāḥ sūryabhakṣyāstathāparāḥ
saṃhārastu mahākālo melāpaṃ paramaṃ viduḥ | anākhyaṃ śaktibhāvaṃ tu bhāsākhyaṃ śaktirūpakam
yoginīnāṃ paraṃ sāraṃ vidhānaṃ kramaśāsanam | siddhakrameṇa āyātaṃ pāraṃparyakramāgatam
caturviṃśatiryāḥ (?) devi kena mantreṇa khecarāḥ | prakaṭaṃ paramārthena tad vadasva yathārthataḥ
sṛṣṭiḥ sthitiśca saṃhāraṃ anākhyaṃ ca caturthakam | bhāsākhyaṃ pañcamaṃ devi tava vaktrāvadhāritam
madanti sarvathā devyaḥ khacakrapadadarśitāḥ | śrībhairava uvāca śrutā etāvad vaktrābjād melāpe militā yathā
tridhāvasthaṃ tridhāmādyaṃ tripravāsaṃ tricetanam | trimūrtiḥ tripathaṃ ramyaṃ akṣaraṃ acyutaṃ śivam
sṛṣṭirdaśamasaṃsthaṃ tu saṃhārādaṣṭame yutam | sthitisthena śirākrāntaṃ navamena vidhānataḥ
tasya puṇyavaśād devyaḥ haṭhādeva khacakragāḥ | prayacchanti paraṃ gopyaṃ aguptaṃ sarvāṅgāṅgibhiḥ
melāpe militā sā vai rūpasya paramā citiḥ | (3 ) dvātriṃśadvīrasaṃyuktā madhye yā svādinī kalā
bhūtādiviṣayairyuktā pūjyā bhasmavilepanī | ṛsyaṣṭakaṃ tataḥ pujyaṃ paścād vidyām prapūjayet
kiṃ vā kandagataṃ devi kim vā hṛtmadhyagocaram | kiṃ vā kaṇṭhagataṃ śubhraṃ kiṃ vā tattvaṃ nāse sthitam
kā guhyā devadeveśi yayā pūjyāstu tāḥ śivāḥ | siddhaiḥ saha yathārthatve parārūpāśca mūrtayaḥ
duṣprāpyā kālakāśāntī daśasaptākṣarāntarā | eṣā saptādaśī vidyā akṣarākṣarayā dhruvam
guruvaktre tu sā kālī labhyate puṇyavajjanaiḥ | sṛṣṭi tu * *? kārasthā bhedinī dehamūlagā
navamena sthitisthena lāṃcchitaṃ kuru mantrarāṭ | mahāśabdaṃ tatoddhṛtya mātṛśabdamataḥ param
tatrasthā paramā raudrā mantrabhūmistu sā viduḥ | rāvajñā rāvagārāvā rāvasthā rāvadā sadā
sarvabhūteṣu bhāvajñe na prakāśyamanopamam ||1/ 51 ||
dravyañca devadeveśa socchakaṃ satataṃ śubham | pūjayet sarvadā nātha vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kārayet
See chapter 15/59 of the Aajñākhaṇḍa śrīmadduttaradigbhāge pīṭhaṃ pīṭhavaraṃ mahat | oḍḍiyānābhidhānante siddhiyoginisevitam
tābhyaḥ  sākṣād purodbhutaṃ  jñānaṃ paramakaulikam  ||2/11 ||
pūjyā vidyā suraśreṣṭha sthiticakrasya bhāsakī | eṣā vidyā mahākāle sthiticakrasya sarvataḥ
dvādaśānte navānte ca ṣaṭtriṃśānte namo'stu te | hṛtpadmakarṇikāntasthe jvālārūpe namo'stu te
akṣarākṣaravarṇajñā daśasaptākṣarā tu sā | kākacañcupuṭākārā kalmaṣaṃ kalayet tu sā
